ambiguities: The actual ChatGPT host behavior after a lock-holding frame closes and remounts remains unobserved; the DIAL-003 owner probe did not cover this case.
blockers: Independent Review and actual two-thread ChatGPT playback, remote Pause, background, rapid-action, and close/remount Verify evidence remain required before feature acceptance.
change_summary: Integrated one exclusive Web Lock and BroadcastChannel coordination protocol into the fixed and country regular players. Play waits for the lock after asking the current owner to pause; an idle frame can request remote Pause with acknowledged or unconfirmed status. Both delivered resource URIs were versioned.
decisions: The exclusive dial-playback-v1 lock gates every audio.play call and remains held through playback; local stop, error, source change, transfer, and teardown pause audio before release.
Transfer and remote Pause messages target a specific owner and playback epoch. Lock waits and remote Pause acknowledgments are bounded; no force steal or timer lease is used.
The implementation uses only browser Web Locks and BroadcastChannel; no backend owner registry, user identity, additional endpoint, or CSP change was added.
The Foreman performed the narrow Git commit of nine Implement-authored files after Git staging required sandbox escalation. Foreman did not edit production files.
tests: npm test after the final synchronous lock request exception guard: exit 0, 22 tests passed, 0 failed; TypeScript build and esbuild browser bundles succeeded.

Shared-lock tests covered takeover after old audio pauses, remote Pause acknowledgment, simultaneous Play, canceled waiter, unresponsive owner Play and Pause timeouts, missing coordination fail-closed behavior, media rejection, and simulated remount acquisition.

HTTP MCP resource test confirmed fixed ui://dial/radio-v4.html and country ui://dial/country-v2.html include the delivered player bundle, remote Pause control, and unchanged CSP allowlists; the delivered browser bundle harness passed tool-result, selection, Play/Pause, and click reporting behavior.
